root_cause: V4148 still performs a full replaceChildren() of the navigation panel on several lifecycle events.
V4149 already owns canonical navigation ordering/state and V7272 observes/decorates the same panel.
When V4148 rebuilds an already-correct menu, it creates a needless full DOM mutation and can trigger another V7272 repair/decorate cycle.
changes: Beta installs an instance-level guard on #v032MenuPanel.replaceChildren().
If the direct data-screen order is already identical, the full menu replacement is skipped.
Real structural changes are still allowed through unchanged.
The guard is reinstalled after DOM/account/extras/foreground/pageshow lifecycle points in case the menu panel itself is recreated.
Diagnostics count suppressed vs allowed menu rebuilds.
